limitations: The helper models local round initialization. It omits graphical palette/music output and does not reproduce Windows message delivery or paint scheduling.
The proof compares source initialization and direct round setup blocks, not entire consecutive matches. New-match AI phase randomization and message-paint priming are separate work.
